description: Unit test for the DefaultAuthenticationResult class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.security.authentication package. The file contains tests for verifying the behavior of authentication result instances, including success and failure scenarios, equality, and exception handling.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationResultTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DefaultAuthenticationResult, testing success/failure creation, equality, null checks, and property access.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test runs, including setting up authorization context, headers, and failure reason.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for DefaultAuthenticationResult.

methods.name: getSuccessfulInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures passing null headers to successful method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getSuccessfulInstanceWithNullAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Ensures passing null authorization context to successful method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getFailedInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures passing null headers to failed method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getFailedInstanceWithNullReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Ensures passing null reason of failure to failed method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: successfulInstanceIsSuccess
methods.description: Checks that a successful authentication result reports success.

methods.name: failedInstanceIsNotSuccess
methods.description: Checks that a failed authentication result reports failure.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersFromSuccessfulInstance
methods.description: Validates retrieval of headers from a successful result.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersFromFailedInstance
methods.description: Validates retrieval of headers from a failed result.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextFromSuccessfulInstance
methods.description: Validates retrieval of authorization context from a successful result.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextFromFailedInstanceOfRuntimeException
methods.description: Checks behavior when retrieving authorization context from a failed result that is a RuntimeException.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextFromFailedInstanceOfError
methods.description: Checks behavior when retrieving authorization context from a failed result that is an Error.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailureFromFailedInstance
methods.description: Validates retrieval of reason of failure from a failed result.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailureFromSuccessfulInstance
methods.description: Ensures accessing reason of failure from a successful result throws IllegalStateException.
